mapper.sql: FROM order_claim c JOIN rental_order o ON o.id=c.rental_order_id LEFT JOIN admin_case_relation rel ON rel.relation_type='order_claim' AND rel.relation_id=c.id AND rel.is_primary=1 LEFT JOIN admin_case ac ON ac.id=rel.admin_case_id AND ac.case_type='claim_review' LEFT JOIN claim_user_response ur ON ur.claim_id=c.id AND ur.response_type='appeal' LEFT JOIN arbitration_case ar ON ar.claim_id=c.id

SELECT c.id,o.id order_id,o.order_no,o.factory_id,o.buyer_user_id buyer_id, (SELECT MIN(s.factory_name_snapshot) FROM checkout_batch_item_snapshot s WHERE s.checkout_batch_id=o.checkout_batch_id AND s.factory_id=o.factory_id) factory_name, c.version,c.created_at,c.return_check_id,ac.id case_id,c.claim_status status,c.problem_type,c.problem_summary summary,c.claimed_amount_fen claimed_fen, c.approved_amount_fen approved_loss_fen,c.available_deposit_amount_fen_snapshot available_deposit_fen,c.user_response_deadline_at response_deadline_at, c.admin_review_remark review_remark,ur.response_remark appeal_reason,ar.id arbitration_id,c.affected_items_json items,c.evidence_reference_json evidence

where.if: AND o.buyer_user_id=#{filter.buyerId} AND c.user_response_deadline_at IS NOT NULL

mapper.select: ORDER BY c.created_at DESC,c.id DESC LIMIT #{page.pageSize} OFFSET #{page.offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE order_claim SET problem_type=#{input.problemType},problem_summary=#{input.summary},claimed_amount_fen=#{input.claimedFen}, affected_items_json=#{items},evidence_reference_json=#{evidence},version=version+IF(#{advance},1,0),updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND claim_status='draft'
UPDATE order_return_check SET claim_created=0,version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{check} AND claim_created=1 AND closed_at IS NULL
UPDATE inventory_reservation SET reservation_status='disputed_holding',version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE rental_order_id=#{order} AND reservation_status IN ('renting','overdue_holding')

UPDATE inventory_reservation r SET reservation_status=IF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_fulfillment_event e WHERE e.rental_order_id=r.rental_order_id AND e.event_type='rental_overdue'),'overdue_holding','renting'), version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE rental_order_id=#{order} AND reservation_status='disputed_holding'
UPDATE rental_order SET deposit_status='frozen_by_claim',version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{order} AND deposit_status='paid'
UPDATE rental_order SET deposit_status=IF(deposit_deducted_amount_fen>0,'partially_deducted','paid'),version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{order} AND deposit_status='frozen_by_claim'

UPDATE order_return_check rc SET auto_close_at=TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND,remaining_close_ms*1000,#{at}), check_status=IF(warning_at<=#{at},'warning','pending'),remaining_close_ms=NULL,updated_at=#{at},version=version+1 WHERE rental_order_id=#{order} AND closed_at IS NULL AND remaining_close_ms IS NOT NULL AND claim_created=0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_issue_report i WHERE i.rental_order_id=rc.rental_order_id AND i.fulfillment_effect='paused' AND i.issue_status NOT IN ('closed','resolved')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_claim c WHERE c.rental_order_id=rc.rental_order_id AND c.claim_status NOT IN ('draft','withdrawn','closed','rejected')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arbitration_case a WHERE a.rental_order_id=rc.rental_order_id AND a.case_status NOT IN ('closed','cancelled')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_intervention_record pi WHERE pi.rental_order_id=rc.rental_order_id AND pi.intervention_status IN ('open','processing')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_case_action a WHERE a.target_id=rc.rental_order_id AND a.action_type='resolve_order_issue' AND a.operator_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND a.action_status IN ('executing','failed','succeeded') AND a.request_payload_json->>'$.fulfillment_decision'='terminate')

UPDATE order_claim SET claim_status=#{state},admin_review_status=COALESCE(#{review},admin_review_status), admin_review_remark=COALESCE(#{reason},admin_review_remark),approved_amount_fen=COALESCE(#{loss},approved_amount_fen), available_deposit_amount_fen_snapshot=COALESCE(#{deposit},available_deposit_amount_fen_snapshot), reviewed_at=IF(#{actor} IS NULL,reviewed_at,#{at}),reviewed_by_admin_user_id=COALESCE(#{actor},reviewed_by_admin_user_id), user_response_deadline_at=IF(#{state}='waiting_user_response',DATE_ADD(#{at},INTERVAL 48 HOUR),user_response_deadline_at), withdrawn_at=IF(#{state}='withdrawn',#{at},withdrawn_at),updated_at=#{at},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_evidence_record WHERE id=#{id} AND rental_order_id=#{order} AND uploaded_by_user_id=#{actor} AND draft_removed_at IS NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE order_evidence_record SET claim_id=#{id} WHERE rental_order_id=#{order} AND claim_id IS NULL AND id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM order_claim WHERE id>#{after} AND claim_status='waiting_user_response' AND user_response_deadline_at<=#{at} ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
SELECT rental_order_id FROM order_return_check WHERE rental_order_id>#{after} AND remaining_close_ms IS NOT NULL AND claim_created=0 AND closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY rental_order_id LIMIT 100
